description: cfd_2d_nwt with the one-step scheme with two projections (N 40 6): the half step u(n+1/2), p(n+1/2) projected with dt/2, the level set moved with u(n+1/2), the full step with u(n+1/2) as the advecting velocity, p(n+1/2) and the density of the mid-step level set, Crank-Nicolson diffusion (validation 75).
covers: the projection with the weight 1/2 (pjm_corr), godunov with a separate advecting velocity
